verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצָּרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’el- Yah·weh baṣ·ṣā·rā·ṯāh lî qā·rā·ṯî way·ya·‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: A song of ascents In my distress I cried to the LORD and He answered me
verses.literalPt: A Jeová, na minha tribulação, clamei, e ele me respondeu.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־ שֶׁ֑קֶר מִלָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh haṣ·ṣî·lāh nap̄·šî miś·śə·p̄aṯ- še·qer mil·lā·šō·wn rə·mî·yāh
verses.literal: Deliver my soul O LORD from lying lips and a deceitful tongue
verses.literalPt: Livra, Jeová, de lábios mentirosos a minha alma e da língua enganadora.

verses.original: מַה־ יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־ יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yit·tên lə·ḵā ū·mah- yō·sîp̄ lāḵ lā·šō·wn rə·mî·yāh
verses.literal: What will He do to you and what will be added to you O deceitful tongue
verses.literalPt: Que te será dado e que te será acrescentado, língua enganadora?

verses.original: חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים׃
verses.literal: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior with burning coals of the broom tree
verses.literalPt: Agudas setas do valente, juntamente com carvões de giestas.

verses.original: אֽוֹיָה־ לִ֭י כִּי־ גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם־ אָהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·yāh- lî kî- ḡar·tî me·šeḵ šā·k̲an·tî ‘im- ’ā·ho·lê qê·ḏār
verses.literal: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech that I live among the tents of Kedar
verses.literalPt: Ai de mim, que peregrino em Meseque e habito entre as tendas de Quedar!

verses.original: רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה־ לָּ֣הּ נַפְשִׁ֑י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: rab·baṯ šā·ḵə·nāh- lāh nap̄·šî ‘im śō·w·nê šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace
verses.literalPt: Há muito que a minha alma habita com aquele que odeia a paz.

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ שָׁ֭לוֹם וְכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר הֵ֝֗מָּה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.literal: I am in favor of peace but when I speak they want war
verses.literalPt: Eu sou pela paz, mas, quando falo, eles são pela guerra.
